finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`, but the code still read `options.retries` (undefined), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check only handled `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

The remaining 8 warnings (DEP0142/198/233/250/267 deprecations plus a couple of `WARN Wxxxx` API/lint-style notices) are pre-existing noise unrelated to the crash — didn't touch those since you said the goal was getting the build clean, not silencing every warning. Let me know if you'd also like those deprecations addressed.
